problem_statement:
Implement a Content Submission feature with version tracking for the XHS Campaign Service.

## Overview
Content creators need to submit content drafts for brand campaigns, track revisions through a versioning system, and manage the submission lifecycle from draft to review.

## Requirements

### Model: ContentSubmission (app/models/submission.py)
Create a `ContentSubmission` SQLAlchemy model in the `content_submissions` table with the following fields:
- `id`: String(36), primary key, default=generate_uuid
- `campaign_id`: String(36), NOT NULL (no foreign key constraint — Campaign model does not exist yet)
- `creator_id`: String(36), foreign key to users.id, NOT NULL
- `title`: String(200), NOT NULL
- `body`: Text, NOT NULL
- `media_urls`: JSON, nullable (list of URL strings)
- `version`: Integer, default=1, NOT NULL
- `previous_version_id`: String(36), nullable (self-referencing, links to the previous version's submission ID)
- `status`: Enum(SubmissionStatus) with values: draft, submitted, pending_brand_review, revision_requested, brand_approved, pending_compliance, ready_to_publish
- `submitted_at`: DateTime(timezone=True), nullable
- Use TimestampMixin and SoftDeleteMixin from app.models.base
- Add indexes on campaign_id, creator_id, and status

Register the model in app/models/__init__.py.

### Schemas (app/schemas/submission.py)
- `SubmissionCreate`: campaign_id (str), title (str, min_length=1, max_length=200), body (str, min_length=50), media_urls (list[str] | None = None)
- `SubmissionUpdate`: title (str | None), body (str | None, min_length=50 if provided), media_urls (list[str] | None) — all optional
- `SubmissionResponse`: all model fields with from_attributes=True

### Repository (app/repositories/submission_repo.py)
Follow the UserRepository pattern. Implement:
- `get_by_id(submission_id)` — returns submission or None, excludes soft-deleted
- `list_by_campaign(campaign_id, status?, page, page_size)` — paginated list with optional status filter
- `list_by_creator(creator_id, page, page_size)` — paginated list by creator
- `get_latest_version(campaign_id, creator_id)` — returns the highest-version submission for a campaign+creator pair
- `create(submission)` — persist and return
- `update(submission)` — flush and refresh

### Service (app/services/submission_service.py)
- `create_draft(data, creator_id)`: Validate body >= 50 chars (raise ValidationError if too short). Create submission with status=draft, version=1.
- `update_draft(submission_id, data)`: Only allowed if status==draft (raise ConflictError otherwise). Validate body length if body is provided.
- `submit_for_review(submission_id)`: Only if status==draft. Set status=submitted, set submitted_at=now(UTC). Raise ConflictError if not draft.
- `create_revision(submission_id)`: Only from submitted, revision_requested, or brand_approved status. Creates a new submission with version+1, previous_version_id=original.id, status=draft. Raise ConflictError if source status is draft.
- `get_submission(submission_id)`, `list_by_campaign(...)`, `list_by_creator(...)`

### API Endpoints (app/api/v1/submissions.py)
Use the `_get_service()` factory pattern and `require_role()` dependency from app.api.deps:
- `POST /api/v1/submissions` — create draft (creator role required), returns 201
- `GET /api/v1/submissions/{submission_id}` — get submission detail
- `GET /api/v1/submissions` — list submissions (query params: campaign_id required, status optional, page, page_size)
- `PUT /api/v1/submissions/{submission_id}` — update draft (creator role, owner only)
- `POST /api/v1/submissions/{submission_id}/submit` — submit for review (creator role, owner only)
- `POST /api/v1/submissions/{submission_id}/revise` — create revision (creator role, owner only)

### Router Registration (app/api/v1/router.py)
Add the submissions router with prefix="/submissions" and tags=["submissions"].

+from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
+
+from app.api.deps import DBSession, require_role
+from app.models.user import User
+from app.repositories.submission_repo import SubmissionRepository
+from app.schemas.common import PaginatedResponse
+from app.schemas.submission import SubmissionCreate, SubmissionResponse, SubmissionUpdate
+from app.services.submission_service import SubmissionService
+from app.utils.exceptions import ForbiddenError
+
+router = APIRouter()
+
+
+def _get_service(db: DBSession) -> SubmissionService:
+    return SubmissionService(SubmissionRepository(db))
+
+
+@router.post("", response_model=SubmissionResponse, status_code=201)
+async def create_submission(
+    db: DBSession,
+    data: SubmissionCreate,
+    current_user: User = require_role("creator"),
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.create_draft(data, creator_id=current_user.id)
+
+
+@router.get("/{submission_id}", response_model=SubmissionResponse)
+async def get_submission(db: DBSession, submission_id: str):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.get_submission(submission_id)
+
+
+@router.get("", response_model=PaginatedResponse[SubmissionResponse])
+async def list_submissions(
+    db: DBSession,
+    campaign_id: str = Query(..., description="Filter by campaign ID"),
+    status: str | None = Query(None, description="Filter by submission status"),
+    page: int = Query(1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100),
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.list_by_campaign(
+        campaign_id=campaign_id, status=status, page=page, page_size=page_size
+    )
+
+
+@router.put("/{submission_id}", response_model=SubmissionResponse)
+async def update_submission(
+    db: DBSession,
+    submission_id: str,
+    data: SubmissionUpdate,
+    current_user: User = require_role("creator"),
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    submission = await service.get_submission(submission_id)
+    if submission.creator_id != current_user.id:
+        raise ForbiddenError("You can only update your own submissions")
+    return await service.update_draft(submission_id, data)
+
+
+@router.post("/{submission_id}/submit", response_model=SubmissionResponse)
+async def submit_for_review(
+    db: DBSession,
+    submission_id: str,
+    current_user: User = require_role("creator"),
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    submission = await service.get_submission(submission_id)
+    if submission.creator_id != current_user.id:
+        raise ForbiddenError("You can only submit your own submissions")
+    return await service.submit_for_review(submission_id)
+
+
+@router.post("/{submission_id}/revise", response_model=SubmissionResponse)
+async def create_revision(
+    db: DBSession,
+    submission_id: str,
+    current_user: User = require_role("creator"),
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    submission = await service.get_submission(submission_id)
+    if submission.creator_id != current_user.id:
+        raise ForbiddenError("You can only revise your own submissions")
+    return await service.create_revision(submission_id)

+import enum
+
+from sqlalchemy import DateTime, Enum, ForeignKey, Index, Integer, JSON, String, Text
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column
+
+from app.models.base import Base, SoftDeleteMixin, TimestampMixin, generate_uuid
+
+
+class SubmissionStatus(enum.Enum):
+    DRAFT = "draft"
+    SUBMITTED = "submitted"
+    PENDING_BRAND_REVIEW = "pending_brand_review"
+    REVISION_REQUESTED = "revision_requested"
+    BRAND_APPROVED = "brand_approved"
+    PENDING_COMPLIANCE = "pending_compliance"
+    READY_TO_PUBLISH = "ready_to_publish"
+
+
+class ContentSubmission(Base, TimestampMixin, SoftDeleteMixin):
+    __tablename__ = "content_submissions"
+
+    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    campaign_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), nullable=False)
+    creator_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
+        String(36), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False
+    )
+    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), nullable=False)
+    body: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
+    media_urls: Mapped[list | None] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=True)
+    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=1, nullable=False)
+    previous_version_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(36), nullable=True)
+    status: Mapped[SubmissionStatus] = mapped_column(
+        Enum(SubmissionStatus), nullable=False
+    )
+    submitted_at: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(
+        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True
+    )
+
+    __table_args__ = (
+        Index("ix_content_submissions_campaign_id", "campaign_id"),
+        Index("ix_content_submissions_creator_id", "creator_id"),
+        Index("ix_content_submissions_status", "status"),
+    )
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"<ContentSubmission {self.id} v{self.version} ({self.status.value})>"

+from sqlalchemy import func, select
+from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
+
+from app.models.submission import ContentSubmission, SubmissionStatus
+
+
+class SubmissionRepository:
+    def __init__(self, db: AsyncSession) -> None:
+        self.db = db
+
+    async def get_by_id(self, submission_id: str) -> ContentSubmission | None:
+        query = select(ContentSubmission).where(
+            ContentSubmission.id == submission_id,
+            ContentSubmission.is_deleted.is_(False),
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def list_by_campaign(
+        self,
+        campaign_id: str,
+        status: SubmissionStatus | None = None,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> tuple[list[ContentSubmission], int]:
+        query = select(ContentSubmission).where(
+            ContentSubmission.campaign_id == campaign_id,
+            ContentSubmission.is_deleted.is_(False),
+        )
+        count_query = (
+            select(func.count())
+            .select_from(ContentSubmission)
+            .where(
+                ContentSubmission.campaign_id == campaign_id,
+                ContentSubmission.is_deleted.is_(False),
+            )
+        )
+
+        if status is not None:
+            query = query.where(ContentSubmission.status == status)
+            count_query = count_query.where(ContentSubmission.status == status)
+
+        total_result = await self.db.execute(count_query)
+        total = total_result.scalar_one()
+
+        query = query.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        submissions = list(result.scalars().all())
+
+        return submissions, total
+
+    async def list_by_creator(
+        self,
+        creator_id: str,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> tuple[list[ContentSubmission], int]:
+        query = select(ContentSubmission).where(
+            ContentSubmission.creator_id == creator_id,
+            ContentSubmission.is_deleted.is_(False),
+        )
+        count_query = (
+            select(func.count())
+            .select_from(ContentSubmission)
+            .where(
+                ContentSubmission.creator_id == creator_id,
+                ContentSubmission.is_deleted.is_(False),
+            )
+        )
+
+        total_result = await self.db.execute(count_query)
+        total = total_result.scalar_one()
+
+        query = query.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        submissions = list(result.scalars().all())
+
+        return submissions, total
+
+    async def get_latest_version(
+        self, campaign_id: str, creator_id: str
+    ) -> ContentSubmission | None:
+        query = (
+            select(ContentSubmission)
+            .where(
+                ContentSubmission.campaign_id == campaign_id,
+                ContentSubmission.creator_id == creator_id,
+                ContentSubmission.is_deleted.is_(False),
+            )
+            .order_by(ContentSubmission.version.desc())
+            .limit(1)
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def create(self, submission: ContentSubmission) -> ContentSubmission:
+        self.db.add(submission)
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(submission)
+        return submission
+
+    async def update(self, submission: ContentSubmission) -> ContentSubmission:
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(submission)
+        return submission

+import math
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+from app.models.submission import ContentSubmission, SubmissionStatus
+from app.repositories.submission_repo import SubmissionRepository
+from app.schemas.common import PaginatedResponse
+from app.schemas.submission import SubmissionCreate, SubmissionResponse, SubmissionUpdate
+from app.utils.exceptions import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
+
+
+class SubmissionService:
+    def __init__(self, repo: SubmissionRepository) -> None:
+        self.repo = repo
+
+    async def get_submission(self, submission_id: str) -> SubmissionResponse:
+        submission = await self.repo.get_by_id(submission_id)
+        if submission is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Submission", submission_id)
+        return SubmissionResponse.model_validate(submission)
+
+    async def list_by_campaign(
+        self,
+        campaign_id: str,
+        status: str | None = None,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> PaginatedResponse[SubmissionResponse]:
+        status_enum = SubmissionStatus(status) if status else None
+        submissions, total = await self.repo.list_by_campaign(
+            campaign_id=campaign_id, status=status_enum, page=page, page_size=page_size
+        )
+        return PaginatedResponse[SubmissionResponse](
+            items=[SubmissionResponse.model_validate(s) for s in submissions],
+            total=total,
+            page=page,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0,
+        )
+
+    async def list_by_creator(
+        self,
+        creator_id: str,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+    ) -> PaginatedResponse[SubmissionResponse]:
+        submissions, total = await self.repo.list_by_creator(
+            creator_id=creator_id, page=page, page_size=page_size
+        )
+        return PaginatedResponse[SubmissionResponse](
+            items=[SubmissionResponse.model_validate(s) for s in submissions],
+            total=total,
+            page=page,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0,
+        )
+
+    async def create_draft(
+        self, data: SubmissionCreate, creator_id: str
+    ) -> SubmissionResponse:
+        if len(data.body) < 50:
+            raise ValidationError("Submission body must be at least 50 characters")
+
+        submission = ContentSubmission(
+            campaign_id=data.campaign_id,
+            creator_id=creator_id,
+            title=data.title,
+            body=data.body,
+            media_urls=data.media_urls,
+            status=SubmissionStatus.DRAFT,
+            version=1,
+        )
+        submission = await self.repo.create(submission)
+        return SubmissionResponse.model_validate(submission)
+
+    async def update_draft(
+        self, submission_id: str, data: SubmissionUpdate
+    ) -> SubmissionResponse:
+        submission = await self.repo.get_by_id(submission_id)
+        if submission is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Submission", submission_id)
+
+        if submission.status != SubmissionStatus.DRAFT:
+            raise ConflictError(
+                "Submission", "status", submission.status.value
+            )
+
+        update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+        if "body" in update_data and len(update_data["body"]) < 50:
+            raise ValidationError("Submission body must be at least 50 characters")
+
+        for field, value in update_data.items():
+            setattr(submission, field, value)
+
+        submission = await self.repo.update(submission)
+        return SubmissionResponse.model_validate(submission)
+
+    async def submit_for_review(self, submission_id: str) -> SubmissionResponse:
+        submission = await self.repo.get_by_id(submission_id)
+        if submission is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Submission", submission_id)
+
+        if submission.status != SubmissionStatus.DRAFT:
+            raise ConflictError(
+                "Submission", "status", submission.status.value
+            )
+
+        submission.status = SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED
+        submission.submitted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+        submission = await self.repo.update(submission)
+        return SubmissionResponse.model_validate(submission)
+
+    async def create_revision(self, submission_id: str) -> SubmissionResponse:
+        original = await self.repo.get_by_id(submission_id)
+        if original is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Submission", submission_id)
+
+        if original.status == SubmissionStatus.DRAFT:
+            raise ConflictError(
+                "Submission", "status", original.status.value
+            )
+
+        allowed_statuses = {
+            SubmissionStatus.SUBMITTED,
+            SubmissionStatus.REVISION_REQUESTED,
+            SubmissionStatus.BRAND_APPROVED,
+        }
+        if original.status not in allowed_statuses:
+            raise ConflictError(
+                "Submission", "status", original.status.value
+            )
+
+        revision = ContentSubmission(
+            campaign_id=original.campaign_id,
+            creator_id=original.creator_id,
+            title=original.title,
+            body=original.body,
+            media_urls=original.media_urls,
+            version=original.version + 1,
+            previous_version_id=original.id,
+            status=SubmissionStatus.DRAFT,
+        )
+        revision = await self.repo.create(revision)
+        return SubmissionResponse.model_validate(revision)

+import pytest
+from httpx import AsyncClient
+
+from app.models.user import User
+
+FAKE_CAMPAIGN_ID = "campaign-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
+
+VALID_BODY = "A" * 60  # well over 50 characters to satisfy validation
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+async def creator_submission(client: AsyncClient, sample_creator: User) -> dict:
+    """Create a draft submission and return the response body."""
+    response = await client.post(
+        "/api/v1/submissions",
+        json={
+            "campaign_id": FAKE_CAMPAIGN_ID,
+            "title": "My First Post",
+            "body": VALID_BODY,
+            "media_urls": ["https://example.com/img1.jpg"],
+        },
+        headers={"X-User-Id": sample_creator.id},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 201
+    return response.json()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_create_submission_draft_success(
+    client: AsyncClient, sample_creator: User
+):
+    response = await client.post(
+        "/api/v1/submissions",
+        json={
+            "campaign_id": FAKE_CAMPAIGN_ID,
+            "title": "My First Post",
+            "body": VALID_BODY,
+            "media_urls": ["https://example.com/img1.jpg"],
+        },
+        headers={"X-User-Id": sample_creator.id},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 201
+    body = response.json()
+    assert body["status"] == "draft"
+    assert body["version"] == 1
+    assert body["campaign_id"] == FAKE_CAMPAIGN_ID
+    assert body["creator_id"] == sample_creator.id
+    assert body["title"] == "My First Post"
+    assert body["previous_version_id"] is None
+    assert body["submitted_at"] is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_create_submission_body_too_short(
+    client: AsyncClient, sample_creator: User
+):
+    response = await client.post(
+        "/api/v1/submissions",
+        json={
+            "campaign_id": FAKE_CAMPAIGN_ID,
+            "title": "Short Body Post",
+            "body": "Too short",
+        },
+        headers={"X-User-Id": sample_creator.id},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 422
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_create_submission_requires_creator_role(
+    client: AsyncClient, sample_brand: User
+):
+    response = await client.post(
+        "/api/v1/submissions",
+        json={
+            "campaign_id": FAKE_CAMPAIGN_ID,
+            "title": "Brand Attempt",
+            "body": VALID_BODY,
+        },
+        headers={"X-User-Id": sample_brand.id},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 403
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_get_submission_success(
+    client: AsyncClient, sample_creator: User, creator_submission: dict
+):
+    submission_id = creator_submission["id"]
+    response = await client.get(f"/api/v1/submissions/{submission_id}")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
